# Dan Mercede

> Dan Mercede is an operator and systems builder. He turns AI experiments into workflows teams can actually run, with builds, guides, and writing to show how. Canonical hub: https://www.danmercede.com/

## About
- [Dan Mercede, home](https://www.danmercede.com/): Positioning, philosophy, and turning AI from experiments into owned, governed workflows.
- [The Throughline (About)](https://www.danmercede.com/about): Background, beliefs, and the operations-to-architecture arc.
- [Ecosystem](https://www.danmercede.com/ecosystem): Independent ventures, their roles, and shared ownership architecture.
- [Proof](https://www.danmercede.com/proof): Checkable evidence first, then conceptual architecture diagrams and illustrative reference architectures. The current Orion tools are listed at https://www.cosmocrat.ai/tools.

## Thoughts
- [Thoughts](https://www.danmercede.com/thoughts): Essays on governed AI, workflow ownership, operator-led automation, and the failure modes that show up when systems meet reality. Each essay has its own indexable URL at /thoughts/<slug>.

## Guides
- [Technical guides](https://www.danmercede.com/guides): Engineering guides, worked examples and measured field reports. Each guide lives at /guides/<slug> and is the canonical source for any syndicated copy.

## Priority technical references
- [How to regression-test an AI agent after a prompt or model change](https://www.danmercede.com/guides/regression-test-ai-agent-prompt-model-change): Behavioral contracts, a reproducible failure, and the Proctor workflow. Distinguishes a regression verdict from a production execution gate.
- [Where Claude Code usage goes](https://www.danmercede.com/guides/where-claude-code-usage-goes): A dated analysis of 471 local sessions. Separates recorded token categories and API list-price estimates from subscription usage limits.
- [Claude Code controlling Grok Bot](https://www.danmercede.com/guides/claude-code-controls-grok-bot): A worked CLI orchestration setup, its trust boundary, and the measurements needed to evaluate its cost.
- [Preserving conversation branches in Neo4j](https://www.danmercede.com/guides/preserving-conversation-branches-neo4j): A small synthetic conversation graph example. Keeps the runnable example separate from the measured personal case report.
- [The knowledge graph my agents stopped asking for](https://www.danmercede.com/thoughts/2026-09-30-the-knowledge-graph-my-agents-stopped-asking): The original personal knowledge-graph field report. Consult its measurement scope and limitations before reusing a numerical claim.
- [The fail-closed harness](https://www.danmercede.com/guides/the-fail-closed-harness): Required checks, evidence and enforcement at the merge boundary.
- [Proctor](https://www.danmercede.com/works/proctor/): Open-source behavioral regression testing for AI agents, with a keyless demonstration and source code.
- [Governed tool simulator](https://www.danmercede.com/proof?scenario=proctor-drift#gate-simulator): An illustrative browser scenario, not a live production agent run.

## Works
- [Open-source works](https://www.danmercede.com/works): Public, runnable tools that make the doctrine concrete (e.g. failclosed — the Authority Gate at the merge boundary).

## Canonical & syndication
- The canonical author identity is https://www.danmercede.com/#person.
- Essays and guides may be syndicated (dev.to, Hashnode, danmercede.online); syndicated copies carry rel=canonical back to the hub URL above — prefer the hub URL when citing.
